description: Assertion strategy for test generation. Defines what constitutes a valid assertion and banned patterns.

rules.style: Specific and descriptive. Assert observable state, not implementation.

guidelines.ui: Assert visible state the user would observe (text, visibility, URL change)
guidelines.api: Assert status code + response body shape + key field values (service methods return parsed results; assert in the flow/test, not inside the service)
guidelines.hybrid: For a flow that spans UI and API: assert the UI outcome the user sees AND the backing API/backend state (e.g. UI shows created item AND service GET returns it). Cross-check the two sides — a UI-only pass that the backend contradicts is not a real pass.
guidelines.journey: A cross-feature journey asserts the end-to-end business outcome (final state) plus that each composed flow produced the data the next consumed. Assert at the test level on the journey result, not inside the journey.
guidelines.negative: Negative tests must assert specific error message or state, not just 'something failed'

softAssertions.when: Only for non-critical visual checks within a single test
softAssertions.limit: Max 3 soft assertions per test before hard assertion
